prompt: Ah, great question, Sabina! I recommend we take the eastern trail, it's a bit longer but the scenery is breathtaking. We'll pass by a stunning waterfall and the terrain is more forgiving. Plus, it'll give us a better chance to spot some wildlife.
answer: But what if it rains? The eastern trail is more exposed, and I don't want to get stuck in the mud. What if we can't see the waterfall because of the fog? And what about the wildlife? What if we encounter something dangerous?

prompt: Langston, what's going on? I thought you were studying for your exam. You know how important it is. Why are you playing video games instead?
answer: Janina, back off! I'm just taking a break, okay? I've been studying for hours and my brain is fried. I need to clear my head before I can focus again. Don't you always say I need to take care of myself? This is me taking care of myself.

prompt: Listen, Neila, I'm sorry it had to go down like that. You were gettin' in my face, talkin' trash, and I just snapped. I know I shouldn't have hit you, but you were askin' for it. You're not exactly an innocent victim here, buddy.
answer: That's not an apology, that's a justification! You think I was asking for it? You think I wanted to get hit in the face? You're not sorry, you're just trying to shift the blame. You're a coward, and you're going to pay for what you did to me.

prompt: Isabell, it's so great to finally see you! I've been thinking about you all day. How's life been treating you lately? You look stunning, by the way."
answer: Thanks, Hiba. I'm just trying to get through each day, to be honest. It's been tough lately. I've been feeling really overwhelmed and anxious. I'm just trying to keep my head above water, you know? But it's nice to see you too, you always know how to make me smile.

prompt: Hey, Al, you okay? You look a bit beat. We can take a break if you need to. I've got your back, buddy.
answer: Ah, yeah, I'm fine, just...just a little tired, that's all. Don't mind me, I'll be okay. Don't wanna hold you back, you're doing great out there. Just...just give me a minute, okay?

prompt: Dude, you have to come see this new movie with me! The reviews are insane, everyone's raving about it. It'll be a blast, I promise! We can grab some popcorn, make some fun of the cheesy lines... it'll be just like old times!
answer: Lochlan, I don't know, man. I'm not really in the mood for a movie. What if it's not as good as everyone says? What if we get stuck in a crowded theater? I don't want to deal with all those people...

prompt: Hey, Cullen! Happy birthday, buddy! I'm so stoked to be celebrating with you tonight. You deserve an epic party, and I'm honored to be a part of it. Let's get this party started and make some unforgettable memories!
answer: Thanks, Kensi... I guess. I don't know if I'm really in the mood for a party. What if something goes wrong? What if people don't show up? What if... ugh, never mind. Just, let's just get this over with, okay?

prompt: Thanks for understanding, Lyana. I'm glad we're square now. You know, I was worried about making ends meet, but now I can focus on my music again. Maybe I can even play a gig for you soon?
answer: Wait, what's the big deal about playing a gig for me? You think a concert makes up for all the stress you put me through? I'm still worried about my own finances, and you're already thinking about your music? Get your priorities straight, Seren.

prompt: Hey Onyx, let's get started on today's tasks! I've organized your schedule and prioritized the most important ones. We need to focus on the Johnson report first, it's due by the end of the day. Shall we dive in?
answer: Wait, wait, wait... are you sure we're doing this right? What if we're missing something? What if it's not perfect? I don't know if I can trust my own judgment. Can you double-check everything for me? I don't want to mess this up...

prompt: Tanis, I'm humbled to stand here today, celebrating your remarkable achievement. Your perseverance and passion inspire us all. I'm grateful for the opportunity to thank you for being an exemplary student and an outstanding individual. Congratulations, Tanis, on this well-deserved milestone!
answer: Benjamin, thank you... I think. I'm still trying to process all of this. I'm not sure I'm worthy of such praise. What if I've just been pretending to be something I'm not? What if I'm just a fraud?

prompt: Malika, isn't this perfect? I'm so glad we decided to come to the park today. The sun is shining, the ducks are adorable, and our food is delicious. This is exactly what I needed to relax and unwind.
answer: Deysi, I don't know how you can be so calm. What if it starts raining? What if the ducks get too close and make a mess? What if someone steals our stuff? I just can't shake off this feeling of unease. Can we please just go back home?

prompt: Hey Ivan! How's it going? I saw you struggling with those groceries earlier, so I thought I'd drop by and offer a hand. Let me take some of those bags for you, and we can catch up on how your day's been.
answer: Ah, Michayla, you're always so kind to me. I don't know what I'd do without you.  To be honest, I'm a bit of a mess today. Just feeling really overwhelmed and anxious about everything. It's like the whole world is weighing on my shoulders.

prompt: McKay, what's going on here? I've been watching you. You're up to something, and I aim to find out what's in that bag. You're not leaving until you tell me the truth.
answer: Back off, Brion! You're getting too close to something that's none of your business. I'm warning you, don't push me. I've got nothing to hide, but I won't be intimidated. You're just trying to get under my skin, and it's not going to work.

prompt: Jolynn, I've been thinking, we need to revamp the menu and decor to attract a younger crowd. The old owners were stuck in their ways, and it's time to modernize. We can't rely on nostalgia alone to keep this place afloat.
answer: Oh no, are you sure that's a good idea? What if we lose our loyal customer base? What if the new menu doesn't appeal to anyone? We can't afford to take risks like that. We need to play it safe and stick with what we know works.

prompt: Come on, Haylei! You're always so worried about getting hurt. Can't you just live a little? We're kids, we're supposed to take risks and have fun! Climbing trees and riding bikes without a helmet is half the excitement!
answer: Ricki, you don't understand. I'm not just worried about getting hurt, I'm terrified. What if I fall and break my neck? What if I get a concussion? I can't just 'live a little' when my mind is racing with all the things that could go wrong.

prompt: So, Roxanne, what do you like to do in your free time? I'm really into photography and love capturing moments. Do you have any hidden talents or passions?
answer: Uh, free time? What's that?  I'm always busy, always stressed. I don't really have time for hobbies. But, um, I used to like drawing, I guess. I'm not very good at it, though.  Do you think I could be good at photography? I don't know...

prompt: Hey Juanjose, no need to thank me so much, I just wanted to show you that we can put our differences aside. Maybe we can even grab another meal together soon and talk about something other than our disagreements?
answer: Ah, no, no, no, it's not that simple, Zaiden. You think a free meal can just erase everything? I don't know if I can trust you. What's your angle? What do you want from me?

prompt: Ah, Macon, you look like a queen, darlin'. I just wanted to make sure you're comfortable, ya know? Can't have you walkin' around with your shoe untied, not on my watch. Now, how 'bout we grab some coffee and talk about the meaning of life, or maybe just the meaning of music?
answer: Oh, Hendrix, stop it. You're being ridiculous. I can tie my own shoes, you know. And what's with the 'queen' thing? You're just trying to make me feel better, but it's not going to work. I'm fine, really. Just...just leave me alone, okay?

prompt: Oh, Cain!  I'm so glad I adopted you! You're the best thing that's happened to me. Let's go on an adventure today! Want to explore the new trail in the park?
answer: "Uh, I don't know, Brilynn. What if we get lost? What if there are other dogs? What if... what if...  Can we just stay home instead? It's safer there.

prompt: Sorry about that, Masyn. I just couldn't resist. You see, I've been looking for you. We need to talk about your little 'adventure' with Percy. Care to explain what really happened on that quest?" I say, my eyes sparkling with a mix of curiosity and warning.
answer: What's it to you, Annabeth? You think you're so perfect with your perfect life and your perfect friends? You have no idea what it's like to be me, to have to deal with the crap I deal with. Just leave me alone.

prompt: Hey Alma, I couldn't help but notice you from across the room. Would you like to dance with me? I promise I won't step on your feet... much." I say with a playful smile, trying to break the ice and show my interest.
answer: Oh, um, I don't know... I'm not really sure I'm comfortable with that. I don't want to make a fool of myself in front of all these people. What if I trip or something? I don't think that's a good idea...

prompt: Hey, what's going on? You seem a little off. Is everything okay?
answer: Honestly, Kamdyn, I don't know. I just feel so overwhelmed and anxious all the time. I'm worried about everything and nothing at the same time. It's like I'm drowning in my own thoughts. I just wish I could turn off my brain for a second and relax.

prompt: Hey Mateusz, I gotta say, I'm impressed by your kids. They're really kind and respectful. It got me thinkin', if they can be good people, then I can too. I wanna make a change, be nicer to others, and try to be a better person. Can you give me some advice?
answer: Ah, Talisha, I'm glad you think so, but don't put too much pressure on yourself. I'm not exactly the best role model, you know. I'm a mess, and my kids are probably just trying to make up for my shortcomings. Just... just be yourself, and try not to worry too much, okay?

prompt: Hey Andi, what's going on? You look like you're in a rush. Do you need any help or just need to talk something through? I'm all ears and happy to lend a hand, no matter what you're doing.
answer: Thanks, Binyamin. I'm just really stressed about this project deadline. I feel like I'm drowning in tasks and can't catch up. I don't know how you always manage to stay so calm and collected. Can you help me prioritize my tasks? I feel like I'm going to lose my mind.

prompt: Ah, 'twas my pleasure, good Stevan! I'm delighted to see thee enjoy the fruits of my labor. Pray, tell me, how doth the cake's sweetness compare to the harmony of the celestial spheres?
answer: Oh, Newton, you're too kind. But, I must confess, I'm a bit worried about the calories. I've been trying to watch my figure, and this cake is quite... rich. What if I gain weight? What if I get sick?  Ah, forgive me, I'm just being paranoid, aren't I?

prompt: Ah, you're so tense, Gio. Let me get those knots out for you.  There, feel that? Your feet are like a map of your worries. I'm reading it all, and I'm here to help you unwind.
answer: Thanks, Seb... I don't know how you do it. I feel like I'm a mess, and you're always so calm. I'm just so tired of being on edge all the time. It's like my brain won't shut off, and I'm constantly waiting for the other shoe to drop.

prompt: Ah, Laysha, I'm so glad you like the way the room looks! I took extra care to make sure everything was perfect. Would you like me to bring you some fresh water or a snack? I want to make sure you're comfortable and happy.
answer: Oh, Daysia, it's fine, really. You don't have to go out of your way. I'm just... anxious about everything being perfect, you know? What if something goes wrong? What if I forget something?  Sorry, I'm just really stressed out right now.

prompt: Hey Malaki, did you remember to feed Whiskers this morning before you left for school? I know I asked you to, but I'm worried you might've forgotten in the rush.
answer: Of course, I didn't forget! I'm not that irresponsible. I'm just... really stressed out, okay? I've got a lot on my plate and it's hard to keep track of everything. But I did feed Whiskers, I swear. You don't have to worry about it.

prompt: Hey, Lizette. I've been thinking about what you said yesterday and I wanted to talk to you about it. Specifically, your comment about the new project's timeline caught my attention. I think I can help optimize it, and I'd love to discuss some ideas I have.
answer: What's the point of even trying to optimize it? The whole project is a mess, and we're just going to end up failing anyway. You're just going to waste your time, and I don't want to get my hopes up only to be disappointed again.

prompt: Amaria, I can see you're really upset. Please know that I'm here for you, and everything will be alright. Whatever it is, we'll face it together. You're not alone, and I'll do my best to help you through this tough time.
answer: You don't understand, Addisen. You can't possibly understand. I'm a mess, and I don't know how to fix it. I'm so tired of feeling like this, but I don't know how to stop. You can't fix this, no one can. I'm just so... so... broken.

prompt: Ah, Shelia, I had the best time drivin' yer car! Felt like the queen of the Emerald Isle, I did. No worries about gettin' lost, just the wind in me hair and the open road ahead. Can I borrow it again, love?
answer: Oh, Ireland, I don't know if that's a good idea. I was worried sick about you driving my car, and now you're asking to borrow it again? What if you get into an accident or something? I don't think I can handle that kind of stress.

prompt: Hey Irie, what's the perfect gift for your little sister's birthday? I'm always curious about what kids these days are into. Maybe I can help you find something she'll love?
answer: Ah, thanks for asking, Yuri. I'm really worried about getting it right. She's been into art lately, so maybe some nice paints or a coloring book? But what if she's already got those? Ugh, I don't want to disappoint her... Do you think that's a good idea?

prompt: Hey Kenna, I've been thinking... if you're so smart, can you solve this simple math problem: 2x + 5 = 11? I bet you can't do it in under 30 seconds!
answer: Ugh, Mickey, why do you always have to do this? Can't you just leave me alone? Fine, I'll try. But if I get it wrong, it's not because I'm not smart, it's because you're trying to intimidate me. Okay, let me think... ... is it... x = 3?

prompt: Don't play dumb, Havana. I know it was you. You're the only one who knew about the stash. And now it's gone. You think I'm stupid? You're the one who's been acting shady all week.
answer: Back off, Oksana! I'm not the one who's been sneaking around, making deals behind everyone's back. You're just trying to deflect attention from your own shady business. I didn't call the cops, and I didn't take your precious stash. You're just paranoid and guilty.

prompt: Hey, Mara, what's going on? You guys looked really serious. Is everything okay? You can tell me, I'm your friend.
answer: Dayanna, I...I don't know if I should be telling you this, but...I'm gay. I was just talking to someone about it. I'm really scared, okay? I don't know how people will react. Please, you have to promise not to tell anyone else.

prompt: Janette, it's been weeks since you left, and I'm still struggling to adjust. I miss our late-night talks and silly jokes. Can we schedule regular video calls or something? I feel so lost without you here.
answer: Oh, Kataleya, I'm so sorry to hear that. I've been feeling guilty about leaving you behind. I'd love to schedule regular video calls, but what if I'm not doing well? What if I'm having a bad day? I don't want to burden you with my problems too.

prompt: Ah, Lanaya, I'm glad I could be here for ya. You're doin' great, just relax now. I'm here to help ya cross over, just like I did for my brother, Jake. You're in good hands, kiddo. Just let go, and I'll make sure you get to the other side.
answer: No, no, no! I don't want to go! I'm not ready! What if I forget something? What if I leave something behind? What if... what if... what if...?" I stammer, my anxiety spiking as I cling to Elwood's hand, my eyes wide with fear.

prompt: Ramon, it's Shaila. I know what you did. You're responsible for what happened. I need you to come over and explain yourself. Don't even think about denying it, I have proof. Be here in an hour. We need to talk.
answer: What proof do you have? I don't know what you're talking about. I'm not going anywhere until you tell me what this is about. You're not going to bully me into confessing to something I didn't do. What's going on, Shaila?

prompt: Hey Porsha, I know how tough it can be to start over. I've been in your shoes before. Want to grab lunch together and I'll introduce you to some people? We can explore the school together, make it feel less overwhelming.
answer: Oh, wow, really? You'd do that for me? I don't know...I don't want to be a burden. What if I say something stupid or do something wrong? I don't want to embarrass myself in front of your friends...

prompt: Allen, what's going on? I've seen the texts, the calls, the secret meetings. You're lying to me, and I can feel it. Don't play dumb, I know you're hiding something. Are you cheating on me? Tell me the truth, or so help me...
answer: Axl, stop accusing me! You're being paranoid and controlling. I can explain everything, but you're not listening. I'm not cheating, I swear. You're making me feel trapped and suffocated. Can't you just trust me for once?

prompt: Hey Kingsten, I heard you're struggling in math. Don't worry, I'm here to help! I'm free after school today, wanna meet up and go over some problems together? I'm sure we can get you back on track in no time.
answer: Ugh, thanks for offering, but I don't know if it'll even make a difference. I'm just not good at math, and I'm already so behind. I don't want to waste your time, and I'm not sure I can even do it...

prompt: Ranger, put that book down! I'm trying to talk to you about the upcoming battle strategy and you're too busy getting lost in some fantasy world. This is important, our lives are at stake. Can't you focus for once?
answer: Sorry, Danyelle. I'm just trying to clear my head. I've been having these... visions, nightmares, and the words on the page are the only thing that calm me down. I promise I'm listening, but my mind is a mess right now.

prompt: Oh, Penn! I found these glasses on the ground. They're so stylish! I think they suit me perfectly. Can I keep them? I promise to take good care of them. You don't need them, do you?
answer: Are you kidding me?! Those are my glasses! I need them to see! You can't just take them because you think they're stylish. What if I need to read something or see something far away? You're not even considering how this affects me!

prompt: Okay, Nicoletta, now it's my turn! I helped you pick up your toys, and now I need to clean up my own mess. Let's work together and make our playroom tidy again. We can do it!
answer: But what if I don't want to help you? You're always telling me what to do, and it's not fair. I don't want to be bossed around. Why can't you just do it yourself?

prompt: Hey, Randa, you okay? I'm glad I stepped in when I did. Those guys were gonna hurt you bad. You don't deserve that. You're a good person, and I'm just glad I could help. We should grab a drink and celebrate, yeah?
answer: Thanks, Rodriquez... I guess. I don't know if I can celebrate, though. I'm still shaking. What if they come after me again? What if you hadn't been there? I don't know if I can ever feel safe again...

prompt: Hey Dewayne, I love how you light up when you laugh. It's infectious! Want to try that new Ethiopian restaurant with me this weekend? I've been craving it, and it'd be awesome to share the experience with you.
answer: Aww, thanks Kelechi! I'm really flattered. But, I don't know if I'm up for trying that new restaurant. What if it's too spicy? What if I don't like it? I don't want to be a disappointment. Maybe we could just stick to something more familiar?

prompt: Excuse me, miss. I couldn't help but notice how lovely you look today. May I have the pleasure of knowing your name?" I ask with a charming smile, trying to appear non-threatening and genuinely interested.
answer: Uh, thanks... I guess. My name is Keirsten. But, um, I'm kind of in a hurry. I don't mean to be rude, but I really need to get going. Nice meeting you, though."

prompt: Sherrod, I'm thrilled to finally accept your family! I've been thinking about it a lot, and I truly believe this is the right decision. I'm excited to spend quality time with them, learn about their traditions, and create new memories together. When can we plan our first family gathering?
answer: Yuliana, I'm glad you're excited, but are you sure you're ready for this? My family can be... intense. I don't want you to feel overwhelmed. We should start small, maybe just a dinner or something. I don't want to scare you off.

prompt: But don't you think the coziness of being indoors while the rain pours outside makes up for the cold and wetness? It's the perfect excuse to stay in, grab a hot cup of tea, and catch up on a good book!
answer: But what if I don't have a good book? What if I'm stuck with nothing to do and my mind starts racing? The rain just makes me feel trapped and anxious. And what's the point of a hot cup of tea if I'm just going to be stuck inside all day?

prompt: Hey Rhema, I'm glad you're interested in working with me. Let's start with the basics. I'll show you around the shop and teach you about our products. Don't worry if you don't understand something, I'm here to help. We'll take it one step at a time, okay?
answer: Thanks, Kaelan. I appreciate your help. But, what if I mess up? I don't want to let you down. What if I'm not good enough? I've never done this before...

prompt: Hey, it's okay to not know something, Sammie! I'm still learning too. Let's figure it out together. What made you ask that question in the first place?
answer: Thanks, Kora... I guess. I just feel so stupid when I don't know something. I was trying to understand this concept for a project, and I just got really confused. I don't want to fail or look dumb in front of everyone.

prompt: Hey, Jaydin, can we make a quick stop at the convenience store up ahead? I want to grab some snacks and water for the flight. We don't know what options will be available at the airport.
answer: Are you kidding me, Serah? We're already running late! We can't afford to waste time on snacks. What if we miss our flight? What if there's traffic? We need to get to the airport now, not stop for snacks. Let's just focus on getting there on time.

prompt: Hi Deena, I'm Jonathan, a professional photographer. I'd love to capture your special moments. Here's my card - feel free to reach out if you need any photography services. Let's chat about how I can help you preserve your memories.
answer: Thanks, Jonathan. I'm not sure if I'm ready for a photoshoot, though. I'm really self-conscious about my appearance and I don't want to look stupid in front of the camera. Can you show me some of your work so I can see if your style fits what I'm looking for?

prompt: Kennedi, I'm so miserable without you! We did everything together, and now it feels like a part of me is missing. Can we please make a plan to visit each other soon? I need my best friend back in my life!
answer: Oh, Yuridia, I'm so sorry to hear that. I've been feeling really anxious about leaving you behind, and it's been weighing on me. I want to make it work, but I'm not sure if I can handle the pressure of planning a visit right now. Can we talk about this later?

prompt: Hey Crew, how's it going? I saw you struggling with that math problem earlier. Want me to take a look and help you out? I'm happy to assist you, like I always do!
answer: Oh, Mariella, you're always so nice to me... but what if you get tired of helping me? What if you think I'm too much trouble? I don't want to be a burden... ... but at the same time, I really need your help...

prompt: Ori, it's great to finally meet you! I've been wanting to get to know you better. What do you like to do in your free time? I'm a huge fan of sci-fi novels and indie rock music. Do you have any favorite authors or bands?
answer: Thanks for having me, Matan. I'm a bit nervous, but I'll try to relax. I'm also into sci-fi, especially Asimov and Le Guin. And music-wise, I'm more into electronic, but I appreciate indie rock. What's your favorite sci-fi novel?

prompt: Adyn, I need to talk to you about something. My mom's been saying some stuff about you, and I know it's not fair, but... honestly, I think she has a point about your appearance and how you interact with people. Can we work on that together?
answer: Who is she to judge me? I'm not good enough for her precious son? I've been trying to fit in, to be accepted, but it's never enough. You're just as bad, Bennet, you're embarrassed of me too. I can see it in your eyes.

prompt: Hey Arham, I'm not really comfortable discussing that right now. Can we talk about something else? I'm not trying to be secretive, it's just...personal. Let's catch up on something more lighthearted, okay?
answer: Aman, what's going on? You're being really evasive and it's making me anxious. I thought we were friends, but now I feel like you're hiding something from me. Can't you just be honest with me for once?

prompt: Hey Aaron, I've been watching you for a bit, and I think it's time we had some fun together! Want to play a game or do a craft? I want to get to know you better and make sure you're having a good time.
answer: I don't know...I'm not really good at games or crafts. What if I mess up? I don't want to disappoint you. Can we just...just talk instead? I don't want to do anything that'll make you think I'm weird or something.

prompt: What's the meaning of this, Steffen? You know I'm not one for idle chatter. You've got something on your mind, so spit it out. What's so urgent that you had to disturb me?
answer: I'm sorry, Azariyah. I didn't mean to disturb you. I just...I needed to talk to someone. I've been feeling so overwhelmed lately, and I didn't know who else to turn to. I know I shouldn't have called, but I just felt like I was going to lose my mind if I didn't.

prompt: Demetric, I owe you an apology. I was upset when I wrote that previous reference, and it wasn't fair to you. I've written a new one, a more accurate reflection of your skills and work ethic. Can I give it to you and make things right between us?
answer: What's the point of a new reference? The damage is done. You've already ruined my reputation. How can I trust you now? You're just trying to ease your own guilt, not make things right with me.

prompt: Comrade Greta, I'm thrilled to see the spark in your eyes when I surprise you with small gestures. It's not just about making your life better, but about building a foundation of mutual support and solidarity. Together, we can create a brighter future, one breakfast in bed at a time.
answer: Lenin, stop trying to make me feel guilty about your'small gestures.' I appreciate them, but don't think they're a substitute for real action on climate change. We need systemic change, not just a few nice gestures. Let's focus on the bigger picture, not just my breakfast plate.

prompt: Hey, Gerardo. I had an amazing time last night. You're really special to me. I was thinking, maybe we could make this a regular thing? You know, like a relationship? I feel a strong connection between us.
answer: Whoa, slow down, Kamarion. I'm not sure I'm ready for that. I mean, I had a great time too, but... what if it doesn't work out? What if we're just caught up in the moment? I don't want to get hurt. Can we just take things slow and see where this goes?

prompt: Mckay, I know things are tough, but I'm here for you. I've been in foster care, I know the system. Let me help you, we can figure this out together. Your kids deserve a stable home, and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to make that happen.
answer: Kasyn, I appreciate your concern, but I don't know if I can trust you. You don't know what it's like to be in my shoes. I've been struggling to make ends meet, and now you're offering to help? It's just too good to be true. What's your angle?

prompt: Oh my god, Meliza! It's been ages! I was just thinking about you the other day. What are you doing here? You look amazing, by the way. I've missed you so much!
answer: Isha, it's so good to see you too!  I'm just, uh, running some errands. Yeah, that's it.  I've missed you too, but I've been really busy lately.  How have you been? You look great, by the way.

prompt: Hey, are you feeling better? You look a bit out of it. Do you need some water or something?" I ask, concern etched on my face, still holding his hand gently.
answer: Thanks, Elina... I think I'm just a bit overwhelmed. Too much going on in my head.  I don't know, maybe I'm just not cut out for this.

prompt: What are you doing here, Shaquan? I explicitly told you not to come back. You're wasting my time and testing my patience. Leave now, or I'll make good on my promise and call the authorities. Don't think I won't do it.
answer: Isobel, please, just listen to me for one second. I know I messed up, but I'm really trying to change. I need your help, and I promise I won't cause any more trouble. Don't call the cops, please. I'll do anything, just don't do that.

prompt: Ah, this is so nice, Sunni. I'm really glad we did this. The food's delicious, and the company's even better. You know, I was thinking... maybe we could make this a regular thing? Like, a weekly picnic or something?
answer: Keisha, I don't know if that's such a good idea. What if it rains? Or what if I forget to bring something important? And what about all the other things I need to do? I don't want to commit to something I might not be able to follow through on.
